job.title: Businesss Analyst
job.description:
We're looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst to join a purpose-driven organisation and play a key role in improving how business processes, data and technology work together to support critical operational outcomes.

What you'll be doing
  • Analyse complex business processes, information flows and data requirements
  • Investigate how data is collected, managed, integrated and consumed across multiple systems
  • Translate business, reporting and data needs into clear requirements and business rules
  • Support the replacement and enhancement of key operational systems
  • Contribute to solution design, testing, implementation and change activities
  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, processes and ways of working
  • Facilitate workshops and discussions to bring together diverse stakeholder perspectives
  • Understand the broader organisational impacts of change and ensure solutions address underlying business needs

What we're looking for
  • Senior-level Business Analysis experience in complex operational, technical or data-rich environments
  • Strong process analysis, requirements gathering and business rules definition skills
  • Excellent systems thinking and the ability to understand dependencies and impacts
  • Experience working across business and technical teams
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation and communication skills
  • The ability to simplify complexity and challenge assumptions constructively
  • Experience supporting solution delivery through design, testing and implementation
  • Comfort using modern AI tools to enhance productivity and analysis

Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Business Architect
job.description:
Contract | Wellington

Join a high-impact transformation programme where you'll help shape the future of a large and complex organisation. With a new multi-year strategic direction established and significant investment in business and digital transformation underway, an experienced Business Architect is required to bring clarity, structure, and alignment across core business operations.

This is a unique opportunity to influence how strategy translates into execution, ensuring business processes, operating models, and digital initiatives are working together to achieve long-term organisational objectives.

What you'll be doing
  • Analyse and map end-to-end business capabilities and core operational processes
  • Assess current-state processes and identify opportunities for optimisation and alignment
  • Develop future-state business architecture aligned to strategic objectives
  • Create clear linkages between business strategy, operating models, processes, and digital initiatives
  • Partner with executive stakeholders, operational leaders, and technology teams to establish a shared transformation roadmap
  • Define business capability models, value streams, and process frameworks
  • Provide strategic guidance on business change priorities and sequencing
  • Support the delivery of a coherent and actionable future-state operating environment
What we're looking for
  • Proven experience as a Business Architect within large and complex organisations
  • Strong capability in business capability modelling, process architecture, and operating model design
  • Experience aligning business and digital transformation initiatives to strategic outcomes
  • Expertise in process analysis, process optimisation, and business architecture frameworks
  • Ability to engage confidently with senior executives and navigate complex stakeholder environments
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and strategic thinking skills
  • Experience working across enterprise transformation, organisational redesign, or digital transformation programmes
Nice to have
  • Experience working within public sector or highly regulated environments
  • Knowledge of frameworks such as BIZBOK, TOGAF, BPMN, or similar
  • Experience developing business architecture artefacts that support investment and transformation decision-making
If you're a seasoned Business Architect who enjoys connecting strategy, operations, and digital transformation to drive meaningful organisational outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Test Engineer
job.description:
Test Engineer | Fixed Term Contract | 18months

Are you a hands-on Test Engineer who enjoys building robust automation frameworks, validating complex data, and ensuring critical systems perform as expected?

We're looking for an experienced Test Engineer to join a major transformation programme where you'll play a key role in delivering high-quality outcomes across banking and financial services products. This is an opportunity to work on complex integrations, data migrations, and API-driven solutions in a collaborative, delivery-focused environment.

What you'll be doing
As a Test Engineer, you'll be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated testing solutions that ensure systems are reliable, accurate, and fit for purpose. You'll work closely with business stakeholders, developers, and delivery teams to validate business requirements, improve test coverage, and support successful releases.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Building and maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites
  • Designing and executing API, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Validating complex business rules, calculations, and financial transactions
  • Performing migration and reconciliation testing across source and target systems
  • Querying and analysing data to validate outcomes and identify discrepancies
  • Supporting SIT and E2E testing activities, including defect triage and troubleshooting
  • Contributing to CI/CD pipelines and continuous quality practices
  • Ensuring clear traceability between requirements, test scenarios, and automation coverage
What you'll bring
We're looking for someone with strong technical testing capability combined with experience working in financial services or banking environments.
You'll ideally have:
  • Strong experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Postman, Bruno, NUnit/C#, Selenium, Cypress, RestAssured, or Karate
  • Solid programming skills in Java and/or Python
  • Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs, including JSON and XML validation
  • Strong SQL and database querying skills
  • Experience using Git and modern version control practices
  • A proven track record delivering automation within CI/CD environments such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions
  • Strong troubleshooting and defect investigation skills
Highly desirable experience
  • Banking, financial services, lending, payments, or core banking platforms
  • Data-driven testing approaches and parameterised automation frameworks
  • Data migration, reconciliation, and validation testing
  • Testing financial calculations, interest accruals, fees, or transaction processing
  • BDD frameworks and tools such as Gherkin or Cucumber
Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion.

Key Skills
Test Automation | Playwright | Postman | Selenium | Cypress | API Testing | Python | Java | SQL | Git | CI/CD | Jenkins | GitHub Actions | Data Migration | Reconciliation Testing | Banking | Financial Services | BDD | Cucumber | Gherkin

Proven experience designing and implementing scalable self-service solutions, service catalogues, and operational workflows to improve user experience and business efficiency.
 

Key experience includes:

  • Development and configuration across ITSM and CSM environments, including scripting, workflow automation, and platform enhancement initiatives
  • Designed and launched an Employee Center Portal featuring custom-built widgets using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to improve employee self-service capability and user engagement
  • Built operational processes, dashboards, and scheduled jobs to support software licensing management, security compliance, data integrity, and reporting requirements
  • End-to-end ownership of a self-service cart platform, including scoping, development, and deployment for software, hardware, uniforms, POSDs licences, and field service-related supplies
  • Experience supporting field service operations through service catalogue design, fulfilment workflows, and inventory request processes
  • Implemented structured taxonomy models and microsite capability to improve platform navigation, searchability, and content discoverability across enterprise environments
